tasks.Background: The update process for the MyHero application still relies heavily on traditional methods through the Company Portal, which require manual processes, longer waiting times, and user‑initiated actions. This approach often results in inconsistent version adoption across the field, causing delays in distributing bug fixes and new features to all sales users simultaneously.
tasks.Objective:
- Accelerate application update distribution without dependency on the Company Portal
- Ensure 100% version consistency across all users
- Eliminate reliance on manual user actions for application updates
- Enable rapid bug fixes and business logic updates to minimize disruption to sales activities
- Improve operational efficiency while reducing manual distribution overhead on the IT side
tasks.Description:
Over‑the‑Air (OTA) Update is a mechanism that allows MyHero application updates to be deployed directly from the server to users’ iPad applications, without requiring distribution through the App Store or Company Portal.

Through OTA, the development team can:

- Deploy updates to JavaScript, business logic, UI/UX, and configuration within minutes
- Perform silent updates without user interaction
- Maintain a consistent application version across all active users
tasks.Impact (must be in number):
- Deploy in minutes
- Auto update all devices on next app launch
- 66.7% Reduction in app update install time

tasks.Background:
Currently, when multiple orders are submitted concurrently, orders that are reviewed first are not included in the baseline 
for subsequent limit calculations, which may result in inaccurate limit assessments.
tasks.Objective:
Ensure accurate limit calculations by blocking new order if there is still order with status Review, so that approval decisions are based on the 
latest exposure and approved limits are consistently enforced.
tasks.Description:
There will be an enhancement in AYO Principal to configure and whitelist specific IQOS Partners for order blocking. IQOS Partners will be prevented from submitting new orders if they still have an order with 'Pesanan Baru' or 'Review' status.

This enhancement ensures that weekly Max Order calculations are based on the latest order exposure and prevents inaccurate limit calculations caused by concurrent order submissions.
tasks.Impact (must be in number): Minimize limit calculation errors and support more accurate order approval decisions.

tasks.Background: AMO relies solely on time-scheduled sync, so orders completed in the morning and mid-day product changes from the Wholesaler do not reach their destination on the same day. Every sync also re-downloads full product and downline master data even when nothing has changed, making sync slow and wasting mobile data.
tasks.Objective:
1. Push canvassing and CITA delivery transactions to the server as soon as the device is online, without PG action.
2. Deliver WS product changes to the field within the same working day.
3. Download master data only when it has actually changed on the server.
tasks.Description: Enhancement of the AMO sync mechanism to trigger automatically after each canvassing or CITA delivery completion, combined with delta sync for master data. Each master data set (downline master and products) has its own SQLite file and its own version signal, checked through a single lightweight request per sync, so an unchanged data set is never re-downloaded. Product changes on the AYO Mitra side raise a version increment, including on removal with a configurable debounce (default 5 minutes) to group bursts of edits into one rebuild.
tasks.Impact (must be in number):
1. PG: faster syncs and an always-accurate product and downline list; no new screen, action, or error banner.
2. Mitra / WS: existing product management actions automatically become the signal that pushes changes to the field

tasks.Background: The current payment and collection process is still largely dependent on hard cash, requiring manual activities from cash collection and deposit through settlement. To provide customers with a more convenient payment alternative and improve Field Force operational efficiency, QRIS will be introduced as a cashless payment option within the MyHero Taking Order process, without replacing the existing cash payment method.
tasks.Objective:
- Provide customers with a convenient and flexible cashless payment option.
- Reduce dependency on cash and eliminate the need for customers to prepare an exact payment amount.
- Streamline the collection, settlement, and disbursement processes across entities.
- Improve Field Force productivity through a more efficient payment and settlement process.
- Enhance transaction transparency and traceability through payment-status monitoring and detailed settlement reporting.
tasks.Description:
QRIS will be introduced as an additional payment method within the MyHero Taking Order process. Once selected by the salesman, the system will generate and display a QRIS code based on the transaction amount for the customer to complete the payment. The payment status will be updated based on the payment vendor’s response, while the transaction data will be processed through MyHero Backend for settlement and disbursement.

The solution will also include real-time QRIS status checking, payment-status recording, detailed cashless transaction information in the Settlement Report, and payment disbursement to the respective entities. A single QRIS payment can support a transaction involving multiple entities, with the payment allocation and disbursement managed through the backend. QRIS will serve as an additional payment option and will not replace hard cash.
tasks.Impact (must be in number): Saving time field force 15%
